# EXP012_ANOMALY_BENCHMARK_PREPARATION_V1

**A100 → Run all.** Grant Drive access; upload the immutable input bundle and the selected EXP005 transfer sidecar once. Only243 controlled LSTMs are trained. GCN/controls remain frozen. Both prespecified detector arms are prepared; no anomaly detector is selected from nominal diagnostics. **No NASA TEST inference or label evaluation.**

Read START_HERE and PROTOCOL.md. Controlled LSTM context64 is the documented feasibility correction for D-12, not a search. Completion stops at independently audited preparation. Save this actually executed notebook for the reviewer.

## Isolated environment
The scientific lock matches the audited parent stack: Python3.13.15, Torch2.11.0+cu130, NumPy2.1.3, pandas2.2.3 and the full resolved dependency list. Use `virtualenv` directly to avoid the earlier Colab stdlib `venv/ensurepip` failure. Bootstrap tools are engineering dependencies outside the scientific environment; their actual versions and commands are recorded. If host Python differs, `uv` obtains the exact pinned interpreter. No scientific source is patched.

setup_log=LOGS/("setup_"+time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",time.gmtime())+".log")
BOOTSTRAP_COMMANDS=[]
def logged(command,env=None,log_path=setup_log):
    BOOTSTRAP_COMMANDS.append(command)
    with open(log_path,"a",buffering=1) as log:
        log.write("COMMAND "+repr(command)+"\n")
        process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,bufsize=1,env=env)
        try:
            for line in process.stdout:print(line,end="");log.write(line)
            status=process.wait()
        except BaseException:
            process.terminate()
            try:process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait()
            raise
        if status:raise RuntimeError("Safe stop; command failed. Evidence in "+str(log_path))

GPU=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=name,driver_version,uuid","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True).strip()
if "A100" not in GPU:raise RuntimeError("Select an A100 runtime; this version has no CPU/T4 fallback")
BOOT=Path("/content/exp012_bootstrap")
if not (BOOT/"virtualenv").exists():
    logged([sys.executable,"-m","pip","install","--disable-pip-version-check","--target",str(BOOT),"virtualenv","uv"])
BOOT_ENV=os.environ.copy();BOOT_ENV["PYTHONPATH"]=str(BOOT)
bootstrap_versions=subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,"-c","import importlib.metadata as m,json;print(json.dumps({d.metadata['Name']:d.version for d in m.distributions(path=['/content/exp012_bootstrap'])},sort_keys=True))"],text=True)
interpreter=sys.executable
if platform.python_version()!="3.13.15":
    uv=BOOT/"bin/uv"
    logged([str(uv),"python","install","3.13.15"],env=BOOT_ENV)
    interpreter=subprocess.check_output([str(uv),"python","find","3.13.15"],text=True,env=BOOT_ENV).strip()
if subprocess.check_output([interpreter,"-c","import platform;print(platform.python_version())"],text=True).strip()!="3.13.15":raise RuntimeError("Pinned interpreter unavailable")
ENV=WORK/"scientific_venv";PYTHON=ENV/"bin/python";READY=ENV/"EXP012_READY.json"
if not PYTHON.exists():
    logged([sys.executable,"-m","virtualenv","--python",interpreter,str(ENV)],env=BOOT_ENV)
LOCK=ROOT/"provenance/requirements-resolved.txt"
if not READY.exists():
    logged([str(PYTHON),"-m","pip","install","--disable-pip-version-check","-r",str(LOCK),"--extra-index-url","https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130"])
logged([str(PYTHON),"-m","pip","check"])
resolved=subprocess.check_output([str(PYTHON),"-m","pip","freeze","--all"],text=True)
if sorted(resolved.splitlines())!=sorted(LOCK.read_text().splitlines()):
    (LOGS/"ACTUAL_REQUIREMENTS_MISMATCH.txt").write_text(resolved)
    raise RuntimeError("Scientific dependency lock differs; no fits started")
READY.write_text(json.dumps({"requirements_sha256":file_sha(LOCK)}))
RUN_ENV=os.environ.copy()
RUN_ENV.pop("PYTHONPATH",None)
RUN_ENV.update(PYTHONHASHSEED="17",CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1",PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
PROVISION=LOGS/("provisioning_"+time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",time.gmtime())+".json")
provision={"experiment":"EXP012_ANOMALY_BENCHMARK_PREPARATION_V1","engineering_only":True,"strategy":"manual virtualenv; no stdlib venv/ensurepip; no scientific source edits",
           "host_python":platform.python_version(),"interpreter":interpreter,"interpreter_sha256":file_sha(interpreter),"bootstrap_packages":json.loads(bootstrap_versions),
           "commands":BOOTSTRAP_COMMANDS,"requirements_sha256":file_sha(LOCK),"actual_requirements":resolved,"GPU_session":GPU,
           "input_bundle_sha256":file_sha(BUNDLE),"sidecar_sha256":file_sha(SIDECAR),"setup_log_sha256":file_sha(setup_log)}
# Capture the actual notebook when the Colab API makes it available. Never make success depend on this undocumented interface.
try:
    from google.colab import _message
    current=_message.blocking_request("get_ipynb",timeout_sec=30)
    snap=LOGS/("executed_notebook_at_launch_"+time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",time.gmtime())+".json")
    snap.write_text(json.dumps(current));provision["notebook_snapshot_sha256"]=file_sha(snap)
except Exception as e:provision["notebook_snapshot_status"]="Unavailable; save the executed notebook manually after completion: "+str(type(e).__name__)
PROVISION.write_text(json.dumps(provision,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("Pinned isolated environment provisioned; strict CUDA and parent replay gates run next.")

## Run the complete preparation
This cell audits all parents, verifies exact GPU replays, prepares fixed baselines, freezes weights, opens calibration, freezes both detectors and performs the final integrity audit. It never imports or opens NASA TEST. Incremental commits and per-epoch checkpoints are on Drive. Re-run after a disconnect under the same identity. A live lock cannot be stolen automatically.

lock=OUTPUT/"ACTIVE_RUN.json"
if lock.exists() and RELEASE_STALE_LOCK:
    old=json.loads(lock.read_text())
    archive=LOGS/("released_stale_lock_"+time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",time.gmtime())+".json")
    archive.write_text(json.dumps({"released_only_after_user_confirmed_old_runtime_terminated":True,"prior_lock":old},indent=2))
    lock.unlink();RELEASE_STALE_LOCK=False
if lock.exists():raise RuntimeError("Existing runtime lock. Terminate the old runtime before setting RELEASE_STALE_LOCK=True and Run all")
run_log=LOGS/("execution_"+time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",time.gmtime())+".log")
logged([str(PYTHON),str(ROOT/"src/run_exp012.py"),"--output",str(OUTPUT),"--exp005-sidecar",str(SIDECAR),"--provisioning-record",str(PROVISION)],env=RUN_ENV,log_path=run_log)
close=json.loads((OUTPUT/"STUDY_CLOSE.json").read_text())
if close["status"]!="COMPLETE_PREPARED_AWAITING_REVIEW" or close["TEST_evaluation_authorized"]:raise RuntimeError("Unexpected close state")
print(json.dumps(close,indent=2))

## Final handoff — stop before NASA evaluation
The summary is for researcher review. Full results contain new LSTM weights, transferred TCN weights, saved nominal traces, flags and audit evidence; keep the original input bundle for the486 GCN archives. No claim of detector feasibility follows from completion. Save this actually executed notebook (File → Download → .ipynb). Drive `logs/` retains provisioning/execution/interruption evidence separately from immutable output manifests.

export_dir=OUTPUT/"exports"
for name in ["EXP012_PREPARATION_summary.zip","EXP012_PREPARATION_results.zip"]:
    p=export_dir/name
    expected=(export_dir/(name+".sha256")).read_text().split()[0]
    if file_sha(p)!=expected:raise RuntimeError("Export checksum mismatch")
    print(name,"bytes",p.stat().st_size,"SHA256",expected)
# Best-effort automatic capture of the completed execution, outside immutable result manifests.
try:
    from google.colab import _message
    snapshot=_message.blocking_request("get_ipynb",timeout_sec=30)
    executed=snapshot.get("ipynb",snapshot)
    if "cells" not in executed:raise ValueError("Notebook payload unavailable")
    (LOGS/"EXP012_ACTUALLY_EXECUTED.ipynb").write_text(json.dumps(executed,indent=1))
except Exception as e:print("Save the actually executed notebook manually:",type(e).__name__)
provenance_zip=PROJECT/"EXP012_execution_provenance.zip"
with zipfile.ZipFile(provenance_zip.with_suffix(".part"),"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for p in sorted(LOGS.rglob("*")):
        if p.is_file():z.write(p,p.relative_to(LOGS))
os.replace(provenance_zip.with_suffix(".part"),provenance_zip)
(PROJECT/"EXP012_execution_provenance.zip.sha256").write_text(file_sha(provenance_zip)+"  EXP012_execution_provenance.zip\n")
print("Execution/provisioning evidence:",provenance_zip)
print("Drive folder:",PROJECT)
print("STOP: independent review and a separately frozen, explicitly authorised retrospective NASA evaluation are required.")
# Small summary only; full result archive stays on Drive.
files.download(str(export_dir/"EXP012_PREPARATION_summary.zip"))
